thread:
maria: RC build rc-2026-03-20-42 is created and uploaded to artifactory. Requesting final QA eyeball and oncall coverage for promo window 15:00-16:00 UTC. release-notes.md updated with feature list + known issue about embedding cache warmup.

dan: grabbing the artifact and running quick smoke now. I'll kick kv-warm after smoke.

sarah: running e2e smoke suite against staging RC. focus on chat flows and streaming. ETA ~8m.

jack: pinning artifact tag in registry: `rc-2026-03-20-42` -> pinned to promo slot. Also opened a brief change window in calendar.

maria: thanks. key rollback/stop criteria: 1) p99 latency increase > 1200ms, 2) error rate > 2.5% sustained 5m, 3) regression in summarize tests > 5%. If any hit, we rollback.

deploy-bot: [INFO] deploy job created by @maria: `promote rc-2026-03-20-42 -> canary (5%)`

maria: canary plan: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (staged) with telemetry gate between each. sheriff-oncall please watch latency and customer-facing errors.

sheriff-oncall: I'm on pager for the window. will call rollback if cross-thresholds. set me as manual gate for 25->100.

sarah: smoke green on staging, no streaming regressions. small flake on tokenization edge case but not blocking (added to post-promote followup).

dan: kv-warm executed for top 20 prefixes. tail latency improved in perf harness.

maria: all good. proceeding to canary. deploy-bot, run canary.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Starting canary rollout: `promote rc-2026-03-20-42` -> 5% traffic. Logs: 
```
initiated at 2026-03-20T14:01:12Z
nodes: gpu-pool-12a, gpu-pool-12b
metrics hook: enabled
```

jack: added a temporary routing rule to favor lower-cost region in canary to validate cross-region routing. no config drift.

maria: monitor dashboards please: token-cost, request-latency, error-rate, streaming-drop. If anything spikes, call it.

sheriff-oncall: 5% canary looks stable for 12m. p95 up ~10ms, error rate flat. ready to move to 25% on my go.

maria: go for 25%.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Scaling canary to 25% traffic. Gate will evaluate 10m after stable.

(some quiet minutes)

sarah: running a targeted prompt set against canary endpoints; outputs match baseline for the sampled prompts. no quality regressions observed.

maria: nice. proceeding to staged 100% after gate. sheriff-oncall, confirm final.

sheriff-oncall: confirmed. I am staying on for full promotion. if latency p99 > 600ms or error rate > 2% within 15m of full traffic, we rollback.

maria: promoting now. final rollback command if needed: `deploy rollback --to rc-2026-03-19-87 --reason "auto-rollback thresholds hit"`

deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] Promotion complete: rc-2026-03-20-42 -> production (staged). Post-promote hooks triggered: telemetry snapshots, docs webhook, notify #general.

jack: release notes pushed to docs site and sent to product. pinned artifact label verified.

maria: tagging thread resolved for now. followups: (1) investigate tokenization flake (sarah), (2) run cost regression next week with full traffic mix (jack).

sheriff-oncall: standing by for 20m then I'll drop oncall handoff. :thumbsup:

dan: nice work team. :party_parrot:
